title: Arrays & Strings
definition: Arrays are ordered collections. In JS, they are dynamic and can hold mixed types. Strings are immutable sequences of characters.
simpleExplanation: An Array is a bookshelf where every book has a specific numbered slot starting at 0.

answers.question: **Basic:** Write a function to implement the core logic of Arrays and Strings.
**Intermediate 1:** Optimize Arrays and Strings to handle edge cases like empty arrays or negative numbers.
**Intermediate 2:** Solve a standard interview variation of Arrays and Strings (e.g. LeetCode Medium).
**Advanced:** Scale Arrays and Strings for massive datasets or implement it recursively.
**Expert/FAANG:** Solve Arrays and Strings in O(1) space or O(N) time when constraints are extremely tight.
